mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(s.total_score), 2), 0) AS avgScore, IFNULL(MAX(s.total_score), 0) AS maxScore, IFNULL(MIN(s.total_score), 0) AS minScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN s.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failCount FROM score s WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT base.studentId AS studentId, base.failedCredits AS failedCredits, base.failedCourseCount AS failedCourseCount, base.scoredCourseCount AS scoredCourseCount, base.scoredCredits AS scoredCredits, base.passedCredits AS passedCredits, IFNULL(ms.maxFailedCount, 0) AS maxSemesterFailedCount FROM ( SELECT sc.student_id AS studentId, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score < 60 THEN c.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCredits, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCourseCount, COUNT(sc.id) AS scoredCourseCount, IFNULL(SUM(c.credit), 0) AS scoredCredits, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.total_score >= 60 THEN c.credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passedCredits FROM score sc JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.course_id WHERE sc.total_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sc.student_id ) base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.student_id AS studentId, MAX(t.cnt) AS maxFailedCount FROM ( SELECT sc2.student_id AS student_id, c2.semester_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM score sc2 JOIN course c2 ON c2.id = sc2.course_id WHERE sc2.total_score < 60 GROUP BY sc2.student_id, c2.semester_id ) t GROUP BY t.student_id ) ms ON ms.studentId = base.studentId
